WITH hand_tallies AS (
    SELECT p.throws, COUNT(*) AS tally
    FROM player_award AS pa
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = pa.player_id
    GROUP BY p.throws
),
hand_shares AS (
    SELECT throws, tally, 1.0 * tally / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share
    FROM hand_tallies
),
above_average AS (
    SELECT tally, share
    FROM hand_shares
    WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM hand_shares)
)
SELECT SUM(tally), AVG(share), AVG(share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM hand_shares))
FROM above_average;
